problem: People want a personal finance and wealth app they can run themselves. Sure is a community fork of the abandoned Maybe Finance app, for everyday users and self-hosters.

stack.frontend: Rails views with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), ViewComponent, Tailwind CSS and importmap
stack.backend: Ruby on Rails 8.1 with Puma, Sidekiq background jobs, Stripe and Plaid gems
stack.deploy: Docker (self-hosting guide) with a Dockerfile; Sentry monitoring

whatsNew: It keeps a once-commercial, nearly million-dollar finance codebase alive as a community project under AGPLv3. It can be fully self-hosted with Docker.
